selection: inner policy-macro Recall@1; first grid candidate breaks ties
weighting: inverse training policy/RHS repeat count, mean weight=1

decision_rules.ML_YES: a model Full-78 strictly beats BOTH simple baselines in Recall@1 in >=4/5 folds, higher mean, and nonworse mean Recall@3/MRR
decision_rules.ML_NO: both Full-78 models have mean Recall@1 <= best simple baseline and <=2 strict paired wins against it
decision_rules.BOM_YES: Full-78 beats Risk+Master in >=4/5 primary folds for BOTH regressors, with nonworse mean Recall@3/MRR
decision_rules.BOM_NO: both regressors have nonpositive mean primary increment and <=2 strict wins
decision_rules.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE; five historical policies do not support population significance
decision_rules.collapse: Recall@1=0 or Kendall tau-b<0, descriptive warning only

recommendation: CATALOG_HISTORY_PROVISIONAL; fixed before training, not chosen from outer-test results; online deployment remains unvalidated
prediction_ties: scenario name for presentation only; ground-truth ties intact
